facts.subject: main/melee/it/kinds/itluigifireball:it_802C01AC
facts.value: Luigi's neutral-special release callback computes world coordinates from his left-hand joint and passes the fighter object, those coordinates, `It_Kind_Luigi_Fire`, and fighter facing into this routine. The routine copies the requested coordinates into `SpawnItem.prev_pos` with Z flattened to zero, obtains `SpawnItem.pos` through the parent-position helper, records zero initial damage and velocity, assigns both parent references, and requests item creation. On success, the new item's special attributes and facing direction produce horizontal velocity and lifetime; it then enters state 0, is associated with its originating fighter, and receives common item setup.
